nodes.description: Public payable mint function for characters; presale and sale paths, writes charactersMinted and _characterMinted then transfers msg.value to owner.
Public payable function minting up to 10 random rocket parts per transaction and paying 20% of msg.value to owner.
onlyOwner function that records block.timestamp or, after pPeriod, ends the game and drains the contract balance to the owner.
Burns a full rocket set held by the caller and transfers half of the contract balance to msg.sender.
Burns a color-complete part set, computes a win percentage per part type and triggers the payout path; Fuel set ends the game.
Private helper validating four colored parts and the character, burning them, then transferring a percentage of the balance to msg.sender.
Private view helper asserting token existence, caller ownership, matching part type and optional color.
Private function deriving a pseudo-random number from blockhash, coinbase and difficulty to pick and mint a rocket part from remaining supply.
onlyOwner setter toggling the public sale flag.
onlyOwner setter toggling the presale flag.
View function that unpacks token metadata and builds a base64 encoded data URI including the image URL.
Private pure helper packing color and part type into a uint16.
Private pure helper splitting a uint16 metadata value into color and part type.
Private function registering a rocket part type and its initial supply.
Internal view function building the JSON attributes string from token type and color names.
Boolean flag marking the game as ended; guards state-changing functions and is set in migration and claimFullSetOfColors.
Boolean flag for the public sale, set only by updateSale.
Boolean flag for the presale, set only by updatePresale.
Counter of minted characters used for supply limits and token id derivation.
Counter of minted rocket parts used for supply limits, randomness seed and token id derivation.
Timestamp recorded at migration start, compared against block.timestamp plus pPeriod.
Constant period (864000) used together with tTimestamp for the migration time gate.
Mapping from token id to packed color/part-type metadata, written on mint and read on validation and URI generation.
Mapping from packed part id to remaining supply, decremented on each random mint.
Array of the 20 packed rocket part types iterated during random mint selection.
Mapping tracking wallets that already minted a character, enforcing one character per address.
Two dimensional array of Arweave image URLs indexed by token type and color.
Caller controlled address used for ownership checks, mint recipients, randomness seed and payout recipients.
Miner controlled timestamp used in migration for starting and ending the game.
payable(owner()).transfer(ownerCut) in mintCharacter forwarding full sale value to the owner.
payable(owner()).transfer(ownerCut) in mintRocketParts forwarding 20% of msg.value to the owner.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(winAmount) paying half of the contract balance after burning the parts.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(winAmount) paying a percentage of the contract balance after burning color sets.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) draining the whole contract balance when the game ends.
Pseudo-random selection relying on blockhash(block.number-1), block.coinbase, block.difficulty and msg.sender, which is miner/caller influenced.
Boolean parameter of mintCharacter choosing the presale branch.
uint8 parameter of mintRocketParts limiting the number of mints per transaction.
Boolean parameter of updateSale setting hasSaleStarted.
Boolean parameter of updatePresale setting hasPresaleStarted.
Boolean parameter of migration selecting start or end of the game.
Character token id parameter validated in claimEachRocketPartWin.
Part type parameter of claimFullSetOfColors selecting the win percentage.
Win percentage parameter of validateColorsAndBurn multiplied against the balance.
Token id parameter of validatePartType checked for existence and ownership.
Recipient address parameter of mintRandomRocketPart.
Token id parameter of mintRandomRocketPart receiving the packed metadata.
Local variable in mintCharacter derived from charactersMinted plus rocketPartsMinted plus one.
Local variable holding the amount transferred to the owner in mintCharacter/mintRocketParts.
Local variable holding the payout amount computed from the contract balance.
Local variable holding the keccak based pseudo-random number used for part selection.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used to enforce one character per wallet and as the mint recipient in mintCharacter.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of randomly minted rocket parts in mintRocketParts.
msg.sender feeds into the keccak based randomness seed in mintRandomRocketPart.
msg.sender is compared against ownerOf(tokenId) in validatePartType to authorize burning.
msg.sender is used indirectly through validatePartType ownership checks in claimEachRocketPartWin.
block.timestamp is read to set tTimestamp and to gate the game ending in migration.
mintCharacter is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier that reads hasGameEnded.
mintCharacter reads and increments charactersMinted for supply checks and token id derivation.
mintCharacter writes packed metadata into _tokenIdToMetadata for the new token.
mintCharacter checks and sets _characterMinted to limit one character per address.
mintCharacter requires hasPresaleStarted on the presale branch.
mintCharacter requires hasSaleStarted on the sale branch and forbids it during presale.
mintCharacter forwards the sale value to the owner via an external transfer after state updates.
mintRocketParts reads and increments rocketPartsMinted for supply limits and token ids.
mintRocketParts calls mintRandomRocketPart inside the mint loop.
mintRocketParts sends 20% of msg.value to the owner after the mint loop.
mintRocketParts requires hasSaleStarted before allowing mints.
mintRocketParts is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier reading hasGameEnded.
mintRandomRocketPart reads and decrements _rocketPartSupply when selecting a part.
mintRandomRocketPart iterates _rocketPartTypes to find an available part.
mintRandomRocketPart writes the selected packed part type into _tokenIdToMetadata.
mintRandomRocketPart computes its selection using manipulable block values as randomness.
migration writes tTimestamp from block.timestamp and later compares it against the current timestamp.
migration sets hasGameEnded to true when the period elapses.
migration drains the full contract balance to the owner on game end.
migration compares block.timestamp against tTimestamp plus the pPeriod constant.
claimEachRocketPartWin delegates ownership authorization to validatePartType before burning.
claimEachRocketPartWin transfers half the balance to msg.sender with no reentrancy guard.
claimEachRocketPartWin is guarded by the gameNotEnded modifier reading hasGameEnded.
claimFullSetOfColors calls validateColorsAndBurn to validate, burn and pay out.
claimFullSetOfColors sets hasGameEnded when a Fuel color set is claimed and is itself guarded by gameNotEnded.
claimFullSetOfColors reaches validatePartType indirectly through validateColorsAndBurn.
validateColorsAndBurn validates ownership of every burned part through validatePartType.
validateColorsAndBurn transfers a percentage of the balance to msg.sender after burning, without a reentrancy guard.
validatePartType reads packed metadata from _tokenIdToMetadata to check part type and color.
validatePartType calls unpack to decode the token metadata.
validatePartType authorizes the caller by requiring ownerOf(tokenId) equals msg.sender.
tokenURI reads the packed metadata for the requested token id.
tokenURI calls unpack to derive color and token type.
tokenURI calls tokenAttributes to build the attributes JSON.
tokenURI indexes imageUrls with the decoded type and color.
addRocketPartSupply writes packed part ids into _rocketPartTypes.
addRocketPartSupply initializes the supply entry in _rocketPartSupply.
addRocketPartSupply calls pack to combine color and part type.
updateSale is onlyOwner and writes the hasSaleStarted flag.
updatePresale is onlyOwner and writes the hasPresaleStarted flag.
The presale boolean parameter steers the mintCharacter branch and validation.
numRocketParts bounds the mint loop and participates in supply and price arithmetic.
saleStarted is written to hasSaleStarted by the onlyOwner updateSale.
presaleStarted is written to hasPresaleStarted by the onlyOwner updatePresale.
startDeploy selects between recording tTimestamp and ending the game in migration.
characterId is validated by validatePartType inside claimEachRocketPartWin.
partType drives the win percentage ladder in claimFullSetOfColors.
percentage is multiplied with the contract balance and divided by 100 in validateColorsAndBurn.
tokenId is checked for existence and caller ownership in validatePartType.
recepient is the address that receives the randomly minted part.
tokenId is the token that receives the packed metadata in mintRandomRocketPart.
mintIndex is computed in mintCharacter and used for metadata and _safeMint.
ownerCut carries msg.value into the owner transfer in mintCharacter.
winAmount carries the computed payout into the transfer in validateColorsAndBurn.
randomNumber is the manipulable value derived from block fields that drives part selection.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient input parameter of mintCharacter, its semantics are captured by the calling function.
Loop bound parameter of mintRocketParts, folded into the minting function.
OnlyOwner setter argument, equivalent to the hasSaleStarted state transition.
OnlyOwner setter argument, equivalent to the hasPresaleStarted state transition.
Branch selector for migration, its effect is the tTimestamp/hasGameEnded write.
Ownership validated token id argument of the claim function.
Selector parameter determining the payout percentage inside the claim function.
Arithmetic factor merged into the payout computation of validateColorsAndBurn.
Token id argument of the view validator, folded into its checks.
Recipient argument passed to _safeMint inside the random mint helper.
Token id argument written into _tokenIdToMetadata inside the random mint helper.
Temporary token id computed and immediately consumed by mintCharacter.
Temporary payment amount consumed by the owner transfer unsafe operation.
Temporary payout result consumed by the msg.sender transfer unsafe operation.
Temporary pseudo-random value consumed by the weak randomness selection operation.
